implementationPlan.note:
GREEN part 1 landed. NEW apps/daemon/src/daemon-foundation-verification-command.ts = 75 physical lines (target <=250, cap 400 — well under).

Surface, exactly as planned and nothing more:
- FOUNDATION_VERIFICATION_RESULT_CODE = "FOUNDATION_VERIFICATION_RECORDED", documented as naming WHICH durable fact the decision points at; the PASSED/FAILED verdict is deliberately NOT restated in the result code because it is the durable receipt's own fact (same division FOUNDATION_DISPATCH_RESULT_CODE makes).
- createFoundationVerificationHandler(options: {projectId: string; store: SqliteEventStore}): AsyncCommandHandler. The returned closure builds createFoundationVerificationService({principalId: principal.principalId, projectId: options.projectId, store: options.store}) PER CALL — the header comment states why (the service writes every durable phase under its construction identity, so a startup-hoisted service would attribute one caller's verification to whoever booted the daemon). It then awaits service.verify with the five payload values passed through UNTOUCHED (no trimming, no defaulting, no coercion — service.verify takes `unknown` and stays the single request authority), throws `new DomainRefusal(outcome.code, outcome.layer, outcome.code)` on !ok so the ORIGINATING authority's code and layer travel verbatim, and otherwise returns a frozen DurableDecision {commandId, disposition: "DECIDED", effectId: outcome.digest, resultCode: FOUNDATION_VERIFICATION_RESULT_CODE}.
- NO sync handler exported: the registry will reuse the kind-agnostic foundationSyncHandler from daemon-foundation-command.ts (imported, never edited — task rail 1 honoured; that file is byte-untouched).
- No clock, no randomness, no Date, no filesystem, no new schema. No exported column-zero *_LAYER/_LAYERS/_BOUNDARIES const (this module mints no layer vocabulary of its own — it forwards the service's).
- Module header records why the module sits beside the registry: daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts:362 pins the registry's bridgeExports list, so no new export may be added there.
